definition: ἐπί-στασις, -εως, ἡ  (ἐφίστημι), [in LXX: 2Ma.6:3 * ;] __1. a stopping, halting (as of soldiers): ὄχλου, collecting a crowd (see Rack-ham, Acts, l.with): Act.24:12 (WH, Rec. ἐπισύστασις).  __2. superintendence, attention (but see Thayer, see word; Field, Notes, 185 f.): 2Co.11:28 (WH, Rec. ut supr.).† (AS)
